enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on bed. Place head on pillow. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Remain still. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Remain asleep. Turn to right side. Pull blanket. Continue sleeping.

Sit up in bed. Swing legs over side. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on bathroom light. Use toilet. Flush toilet. Turn on sink tap. Pick up soap. Lather hands. Rinse hands. Turn off tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Pick up towel. Wipe face. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

Walk into kitchen. Turn on kitchen light. Open refrigerator. Take out milk. Take out cereal box. Close refrigerator. Open cabinet. Take out bowl and spoon. Close cabinet. Place bowl on counter. Pour cereal into bowl. Pour milk into bowl. Pick up bowl. Walk to table. Sit on chair. Eat cereal with spoon. Stand up. Pick up bowl and spoon. Walk to sink. Place in dishwasher.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and preparing for work
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Select shirt. Select pants. Select socks. Select underwear. Close wardrobe. Take off pajamas. Put on underwear. Put on pants. Put on shirt. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Walk to mirror. Comb hair. Pick up bag. Pick up phone. Pick up keys. Put phone and keys in bag. Walk out of bedroom.

Leave house. Lock door. Walk along sidewalk. Cross street. Wait for traffic light. Arrive at bus stop. Check phone. Wait for bus. Bus arrives. Board bus. Show pass. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Bus stops. Get off bus. Walk two blocks. Enter office building.

Enter office. Walk to desk. Sit on chair. Turn on computer. Log in. Open email. Read emails. Reply to emails. Open calendar. Check schedule. Attend meeting. Take notes. Make phone calls. Type report. Print documents. File documents. Drink water. Use restroom. Return to desk. Continue working.

Leave office. Walk to cafeteria. Enter cafeteria. Pick up tray. Select food. Pay for food. Carry tray to table. Sit down. Eat food. Drink water. Clear tray. Throw away trash. Walk out of cafeteria. Walk back to office. Enter office.

Sit at desk. Open spreadsheet. Enter data. Save file. Write email. Send email. Attend conference call. Take notes. Make copies. Meet with colleague. Discuss project. Return to desk. Type document. Review document. Print document. Sign document. File document. Check email. Reply to email. Continue working.

Leave office. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Bus arrives. Board bus. Find seat. Sit down. Check phone. Bus stops. Get off bus. Walk along sidewalk. Cross street. Walk down street. Arrive home. Unlock door. Enter house.

Enter kitchen. Turn on kitchen light. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables. Take out meat. Close refrigerator. Wash vegetables. Cut vegetables. Open cabinet. Take out pan. Place pan on stove. Turn on stove. Pour oil into pan. Add vegetables to pan. Stir vegetables. Add meat. Stir mixture. Add spices. Turn off stove. Transfer food to plate.

Sit at table. Pick up fork. Pick up knife. Cut food. Eat food. Chew. Swallow. Drink water. Continue eating. Finish meal. Push plate away. Stand up. Pick up plate. Pick up utensils. Walk to sink. Rinse plate. Place plate in dishwasher.

Clear table. Scrape food into trash. Load dishes into dishwasher. Add detergent. Close dishwasher. Turn on dishwasher. Wipe table with cloth. Wipe counters. Sweep floor. Put broom away. Rinse sink. Wipe stove. Put away leftovers. Close refrigerator. Take out trash. Turn off kitchen light.

Enter living room. Turn on TV. Pick up remote. Sit on couch. Change channel. Watch TV. Adjust volume. Change channel again. Stand up. Go to kitchen. Get snack. Return to couch. Eat snack. Continue watching. Check phone. Use phone. Put phone down. Change channel. Watch more TV. Turn off TV. Stand up.

Walk to bedroom. Turn on desk lamp. Open laptop. Turn on laptop. Log in. Open browser. Browse internet. Check email. Type document. Save document. Watch video. Play game. Check phone. Close laptop. Turn off desk lamp.
Pick up book. Sit on bed. Open book. Read page. Turn page. Continue reading. Adjust pillow. Lie down. Read more. Turn page. Close book. Place book on nightstand.

Walk to bathroom. Turn on bathroom light. Use toilet. Flush toilet. Turn on sink tap. Wash hands. Turn off tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off light. Walk to bedroom.

Lie down on bed. Place head on pillow. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Remain still. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Remain asleep. Turn to right side. Pull blanket. Continue sleeping.
